Sun Data Analytics is an independent analytics practice focused on clear reporting, reproducible data work, research support, and practical decision systems.

## Staff

::: {.staff-bio}

![Jonathon Sun](../assets/staff/JS_profile_crop.jpg){.staff-photo}

Sun Data Analytics is led by Jonathon Sun, whose work focuses on data reporting, reproducible research workflows, mixed-methods analysis, and practical decision systems.

He works across qualitative, quantitative, and visual data projects, helping turn messy source materials into clearer reports, dashboards, and analysis-ready outputs.

## Contact Context

Good-fit projects usually involve messy but valuable source material, unclear reporting processes, recurring manual work, research questions that need structure, or stakeholders who need a clearer explanation of the evidence.

For questions, project fit, or collaboration, contact [jonathon@sun-dataanalytics.com](mailto:jonathon@sun-dataanalytics.com).
